title: The Fast Trick to Multiply Any Number by 5
description: Halve, then multiply by 10 — a simple shortcut for multiplying by 5 without needing a calculator.
narration_lines: Multiplying by 5 is easier than it looks.
First, cut the number in half. Half of 48 is 24.
Then just multiply by 10 — add a zero.

params.footnote: half it, then times 10 — because 5 is half of 10
